files.summary: Resumed from the interrupted run; kept the existing content after checking it against PDF pp. 20-24, architecture_overview.md, data_flows.md, coherence.json, critic.json and the canonical decisions. It covers: C4 context, container and component diagrams (Mermaid); a layers table; the three mandatory boundaries, each with its rule, mechanism and CI proof; the threads and workers table (C2); package import rules; the single origin and its header set; the answer to each Puter and daedalOS limitation (§7); the §8.1 rm -r mapping; six walk-throughs, each with numbered steps and a sequence diagram; cross-cutting invariants; errors; budgets; ID-prefixed tests; and the list of candidates for 'two decisions we would reverse'. Fixes made this run: (1) status date set to 2026-09-24. (2) WT1: local vector rows are now tombstoned inside the same IndexedDB transaction through FsSemanticSearch.txnHook/storeScope, matching rag-semantic-search.md §3.3, and the §8.1 mapping row was updated to match. (3) WT4: ai.semsearch now requires fs.read and takes a dir argument, not scope; the ai.search capability belongs only to the scoring daemon. (4) readdirPlus was replaced with readdir {plus:true} and id with proc.cred. (5) WT5: the plan token is renamed to token, binds planId into the HMAC and is one-shot; submit issues the token directly when no confirmation is needed; the audit record goes to the local audit store. All 10 Mermaid diagrams parse with Mermaid 11.13, and every anchor resolves.

New file. Header block and requirements table (SYS-01, §9.6, VFS-03..10, PROC-06/07/08, MEM-01/06/07/08, WM-01/02/05, OFF-04, BOOT-06/11/12, AGT-01..05/08/09/10, RAG-03/06, PRE-04..06, §3.2, §3.4, and Plotinium IDs ABI-01..16). Design: channels and MessagePort transport, including the 64 KB transfer rule and page limits. Identity by port: an executor's syscall frame doubles as the slice-end report and is checked against slice[e]; view ports are bound to (pid, wid). §3.2.3 sandboxes the realm: non-configurable throwing accessors on the global object and its prototype chains. The dispatcher order is ESRCH > ENOSYS > schema EINVAL/ENAMETOOLONG > capability EPERM > rwx > audit > handler, with a flowchart. Call classes are F/T/B/X/R, and ECANCELED replaces EINTR. The capability model uses root-owned manifests and bounding(uid, class), plus a kernel-issued one-shot batch.grant. It also defines the vfs/perm.ts rules (with the critic's root-x fix), trace/security/agent audit levels, event bus rules, signals and job control, ABI_VERSION with a digest handshake, and Valibot conventions (strictObject only, InferOutput, errno message tag, strict LLM tool export). Interfaces: envelopes and port frames; common schemas (Path, Name, UUIDv7 Ino, ModeChange); an errno master table with Linux numeric codes (EAIUNAVAIL 1001, EAIREFUSED 1002), messages and a registry of detail.reason values. The full catalogue has about 110 calls in 11 groups (process, fs, fd/pipes/tty, window, mem, time, lock, net/sync, events, ai rag/agent/predict, sys/admin), each with args and return, class, origin, caps, permission, errnos and audit level, plus a command-to-call map for SYS-02. Also: the capability table and process classes, event topics with payloads and delivery filters, the AuditRecord type, the signals table, and the error mapping from IndexedDB, OPFS, PostgreSQL SQLSTATEs, HTTP, the LLM gateway and WS. Algorithms: dispatcher and identity pseudo-code with complexity, capability derivation, the plan-token/batch.grant algorithm with a sequence diagram, and the event permission filter; invariants INV-ABI-1..8. Also an edge-case table, performance budgets (pilot figures labelled), the SYS-01 bypass suite (8 cases, B1-B8; B5 is forged identity, as architecture.md INV-A3 expects), 74 ID-prefixed tests, open questions and cross-spec requests. All 4 Mermaid diagrams parse, and all anchors resolve, including those that architecture.md links into.

cross_spec_requests: Canonical errno set (C3 / 15-decisions/stack-decisions.md): add ENOMEM (Linux 12) for mem.alloc and mem.declare requests that can never fit the budget or a per-process hard limit. Until it is approved, these return EINVAL with detail.reason 'exceeds-budget'. No other errno is added: POSIX EINTR is covered by ECANCELED, ESTALE by EAGAIN 'stale-plan', EAIRATE/EAIBUDGET by EAIUNAVAIL with detail.reason, and ECHILD by ESRCH 'no-child'.

10-ai/rag-semantic-search.md: rename mm.prefetch to mem.prefetch (§3.5 step 9, §3.10) so it matches C13's mem.* group. Also note: ai.index.status {files:true} requires the ai.index capability, ai.semsearch origin is EV (process and Files view), and ai.index.drop exists for reconciliation.

10-ai/agentic-shell.md: adopt ai.agent.plan (turn 1 carries request plus envelope; later turns carry observations or a clarification; at most 6 turns), ai.agent.submit, ai.agent.confirm, ai.agent.log and ai.undo, with the shapes in syscall-abi.md §4.4.10. Adopt the plan-token rule of §5.4: submit returns the token directly when no confirmation is needed, so every agent mutation goes through validation and a dry run; the token is an HMAC over pid, planId, planHash, dryRunHash and exp, is one-shot and expires after 120 s. Use EAGAIN 'stale-plan' for a changed fingerprint. Write one durable audit record per planning turn for the read-only observation calls. The kernel grep is fixed-string only. find returns the resolved absolute interval for relative dates.

10-ai/predictive-prefetch.md: adopt ai.predict, ai.predict.publish, ai.telemetry.read/clear/export/optin, mem.prefetch and mem.hint, and the capabilities ai.telemetry, ai.predict, mm.hint, mm.speculative and privacy (held by the Settings app). Define the TelemetryEvent shape.

04-vfs/virtual-file-system.md: confirm that each write call on a regular file is one transaction with its own version (base = expectedVersion or the version the fd last saw; a mismatch produces a conflicted copy) and that writeFile is an atomic whole-content replace. Also confirm: readdir pagination (at most 1,000 entries) with a plus flag; find/grep/du/wc as kernel R-class calls; EXDEV at /mnt mount boundaries; the protected-hardlink rule (source owned by the caller, or root); chmod in set/delta form; setuid/setgid bits rejected with EINVAL in v1; well-known fixed inode UUIDs using the version-7 layout with a zero timestamp (e.g. 00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001) so the Ino schema accepts them.

04-vfs/virtual-file-system.md and 09-database/database.md: add an IndexedDB 'audit' store (key auditId, indexes uid and promptId, durability strict) to the C4 store list. AGT-08 needs it so that 'ai log' works offline. Make the server audit_log columns match AuditRecord in syscall-abi.md §4.7 (INSERT/SELECT only for the app role).

09-database/database.md: confirm the SQLSTATE-to-errno mapping in syscall-abi.md §4.9 (23505 EEXIST, 23503 ENOENT, 23514 by constraint name, 23P01 EBUSY, 55P03 EBUSY, 40001/40P01 retry then EAGAIN, P0001 EIO, 57014 ECANCELED). Give the acyclicity trigger its own SQLSTATE, distinct from the fault trigger's P0001 (already requested in architecture.md §9.3).

03-kernel/processes-and-scheduling.md: the executor's syscall frame {t:'syscall', pid, sliceSeq, cpuMs, req} is also the slice-end report. Dispatch and resume frames carry pendingSigs. Programs may export a synchronous signal(ctx, st, sig) hook that only updates serialisable state. The executor isolation key is (uid, class) with classes user, agent and system. Interrupted blocking calls return ECANCELED; wait with no matching child returns ESRCH 'no-child'. A second identity mismatch on one executor terminates it through the watchdog path.

03-kernel/memory-and-paging.md: adopt the mem.alloc/declare/free/stat/prefetch/hint shapes and MemStat from syscall-abi.md §4.4.5, keeping reservation admission (block on 'mem'). Add sysctl keys mm.budgetMB, mm.softLimitMB and mm.swap.tier (auto | local | remote, used for demos). Define the reclaim low watermark and dual-location PTEs (already requested in architecture.md §9.3).

02-boot/boot-and-services.md: add 'class' and 'caps' fields to the 18 service manifests (C17) and to /bin/<app>.json manifests next to 'requires'. List each service's capabilities (e.g. ai.indexer: fs.read, mem, ai.index; ai.search: ai.search, mem; ai.predictor: ai.telemetry, ai.predict, mm.hint, mm.speculative; login/desktop: auth.session, window, proc). State when the router installs the ARC-07 shadows.

05-wm/window-manager.md: mount each window's view in a closed shadow root (SYS-01 case B6). Bind a view port to (pid, wid) at window.create and pass it to the view with a transferred display channel. Implement the 1,000 ms user-activation rule for window.focus (otherwise downgrade to requestAttention). Closing a window sends SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 3 s.

07-shell/shell-and-terminal.md: the TTY line discipline runs in the kernel and owns the ai.agent.confirm prompt (answers only from real keystrokes). Implement tty.open/input/resize/getattr/setattr, tcsetpgrp/tcgetpgrp and the job-control signals (SIGINT, SIGTSTP, SIGQUIT, SIGHUP, SIGWINCH, SIGTTIN, SIGTTOU). Use the command-to-call map in syscall-abi.md §4.4.12. The grep command does regex matching in its own process, not in the kernel.

06-sync/offline-and-sync.md: define NetStatus as in syscall-abi.md §4.4.8, a welcome.faultInjection flag (true only when FAULT_INJECTION=1), SYNC_WAIT_MS (proposed 10 s), per-owner hello.resume, and op.result errnos drawn only from the master table in §4.3. proc.signal on the control lane triggers pg_cancel_backend for AGT-09.

11-server/backend-api.md: map HTTP statuses as in syscall-abi.md §4.9 (403 EACCES, 404 ENOENT, 409 EAGAIN, 413/422 EINVAL, 429 EAGAIN with retryAfterMs, 503 on /api/llm EAIUNAVAIL). Validate /api/* bodies with the protocol/ Valibot schemas in preValidation. Provide the su verification endpoint (15-minute grant) and the root-only, audited fault-injection and debug.delay harness scoped to one os_session_id.

12-security/security-model.md: record the capability model and bounding sets, the per-boot HMAC key for plan tokens, the executor realm sandboxing, and the residual risk that shadowing views on the main thread can be bypassed (defence in depth only; v1 runs first-party code).

13-quality/testing-and-performance.md: register the ABI tests (syscall-abi.md §8), the fast-check dispatcher fuzz project, and the budgets in §7 (stat RTT p95 <= 1 ms under UI load, dispatcher stages <= 20 us, readdir page limits, confirm prompt <= 100 ms). Add ARC-04 as already requested.
00-product/requirements-traceability.md: register the Plotinium ID prefixes ABI- (ABI-01..ABI-16) and ARC- (ARC-01..ARC-08) so tools/traceability.ts accepts them.
00-product/identity-and-branding.md: the UnameInfo shape is adopted unchanged for the uname syscall; identity comes from the calling port's PCB.
open_questions: Instructor: POSIX EINTR is not in the canonical errno set, so blocking calls interrupted by a caught signal return ECANCELED. Is that acceptable, given that spec §9.3 lists only the file-system errnos?

Instructor: is a closed shadow root per window, plus lint and the built-chunk scan, acceptable enforcement of 'no application touches another application's windows' for views on the main thread (SYS-01 case B6)?
Instructor: is placing the kernel in a worker acceptable given Figure 8.1? The team cites §8 p. 22 ('a reference, not a prescription') and boundary 2. This carries over from architecture.md §9.2.
Instructor: if a second machine is not available on Demo Day, are two Chrome profiles on one machine acceptable for §7.3 'two users on two machines'?

Team (Week-5 kernel spike): confirm that redefining indexedDB/caches/storage/locks/Worker/fetch accessors on the executor's global object and prototype chains works in current stable Chrome. The ai.embed special worker is not shadowed and must still run Transformers.js.

Team: should lsof show other users' open fds to non-root users (currently root only; leases stay visible to anyone with r on the file, as VFS-09 needs)? Should proc.list show other users' full argv (currently argv[0] only)?
Team: until ENOMEM is approved, mem.alloc and mem.declare above the whole budget return EINVAL 'exceeds-budget'. Confirm this interim behaviour.
Team: the empty path '' is rejected with EINVAL at the schema stage (POSIX says ENOENT). Keep this, or add an 'ENOENT' schema tag?

Lab machine (Week 2): hardwareConcurrency and RAM set RUN_TOKENS, MAX_EXECUTORS and whether the 256 MB budget plus the ~100 MiB ai.embed page fit. All ABI latency budgets must be re-measured there (pilot figures are labelled).
